rules: Same-event downstream disclosures are merged, never counted as separate attacks.
Publication, occurrence, detection, status and source-check dates remain separate.
Confirmed versus possible/investigating scope, units, maximums, overlapping counts and subsets remain separate.
No attacker claims, leaked datasets or AI causation included.
Failed/unreadable source checks do not advance publication or source verification dates.

limits: Selected incident discovery is not exhaustive; no blanket absence-of-follow-up claim is made.
Six added entries include previously unrecorded older events with recent follow-ups, not six attacks newly occurring October13.
Only individually read sources have new check evidence. Updated incident verification dates do not mean every historic cited source was retrieved again.
Ride On provider is unnamed; it is not merged into IDCF based on timing alone.
Bookoff direct PDF retrieval failed but official complete text succeeded through web extraction. Kindal Japanese PDF remained inaccessible; official JPX-hosted English version was verified.
Sagawa general index was unavailable; fourth-report and FAQ bodies were recovered through their own public XML endpoints.
Pre-publication review clarifies Ride On detection as October 5 onward and Kindal September 2/October 13 as disclosure dates, not exact investigation milestone dates.
auditPolicy: Raw response hashes only where bytes actually retrieved. No PDF hash invented for web-only extraction. Body caches stay outside repository. Publication dates, status dates and actual UTC check times remain separate.
